    Classical Greece · a statueZeusDark bronze · Greece · c. 460–450 BCE · Zeus or PoseidonA real 3D scan by SMK, the National Gallery of Denmark, of the full-size plaster cast (KAS2100) in its Royal Cast Collection of the bronze raised from the sea off Cape Artemision, now in the National Archaeological Museum, Athens; SMK released the scan into the public domain (CC0 1.0). The Archives lightened the body's mesh for phones (the head keeps the scan's full detail), added the drape, and dressed it in one dark bronze, the metal of the original where the scanned cast is plaster: that finish and the drape are ours.Scholars still disagree on who he is: if the lost weapon in the raised hand was a thunderbolt he is Zeus, if a trident, Poseidon. The hand is empty, and the question is open.Recently added, pending full review.Classical GreeceZeus in the Pantheon
    Interpretive display. The
